name: TKO GROUP HOLDINGS, INC.

overrides_applied.source: Form 10-K for fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 (filed 2026-02-25, accession 0001193125-26-071651), Consolidated Statements of Cash Flows, investing activities line 'Purchases of property, buildings and equipment and other assets': $(126,953) thousand for FY2025, with $(118,818) thousand for FY2024 and $(93,753) thousand for FY2023 in the same statement. The line is tagged in the filing's inline XBRL only under TKO's extension tag tko:PaymentsToAcquirePropertyPlantAndEquipmentAndOther, which EDGAR companyfacts does not carry (CIK 1973266 facts contain only us-gaap/dei/ecd namespaces and no standard capex tag), so the engine filed no capex value for any period. Corroborated in the Q2 2026 Form 10-Q (accession 0001193125-26-330592), same line: $(44,444) thousand for H1 2026 vs $(48,631) thousand for H1 2025.
overrides_applied.reason: DATA_GAP:capex - capex missing for FY2023, FY2024, FY2025 of the last 3 in EDGAR companyfacts under every candidate tag the engine reads; the filer's own cash-flow statement reports this capex line for all three years. The engine applies this single FY2025 filing value to every missing period; the FY2023/FY2024 filing values in the same statement ($93.753M / $118.818M) are the same magnitude, capex is only ~2.7% of FY2025 revenue and ~10% of OCF, and the median year of the last-3 base is FY2024, where the single value overstates true capex by $8.135M (~$0.05/share on that year's share count) - immaterial to the verdict and conservative (it lowers OE). ttm.py prorates the same value across its legs, giving TTM capex of exactly the FY2025 figure vs a true filed-leg TTM of $122.766M (FY2025 $126.953M - H1 2025 $48.631M + H1 2026 $44.444M, both H1 legs from the Q2 2026 10-Q) - a $4.187M difference, ~0.3% of TTM OE.

fragility_flags: STALE_FY: latest fiscal year ended 9 months ago — check TTM/quarterly OE and consider --base-oe-ps override
DILUTION: share count growing 53.0%/yr — already deducted via the growth adjustment; check SBC trend
BASIS_BREAK_SUSPECT: a >60% revenue jump/drop in the last 5 yrs — check for divestitures, big M&A, or restatements before trusting any CAGR
OE_VOLATILE: OE/share range over the last 5 yrs spans >3x — normalized base helps but the business is cyclical; widen bear weight
NI_OCF_DIVERGENCE: net income and operating cash flow differ by >40% in 2023, 2024, 2025 — find the one-off (tax deposits, impairments, WC swings) before trusting the OE base

OVERRIDE_APPLIED:capex — filing gap in the last 3 FY filled by a judgment override (filing: Form 10-K for fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 (filed 2026-02-25, accession 0001193125-26-071651), Consolidated Statements of Cash Flows, investing activities line 'Purchases of property, buildings and equipment and other assets': $(126,953) thousand for FY2025, with $(118,818) thousand for FY2024 and $(93,753) thousand for FY2023 in the same statement. The line is tagged in the filing's inline XBRL only under TKO's extension tag tko:PaymentsToAcquirePropertyPlantAndEquipmentAndOther, which EDGAR companyfacts does not carry (CIK 1973266 facts contain only us-gaap/dei/ecd namespaces and no standard capex tag), so the engine filed no capex value for any period. Corroborated in the Q2 2026 Form 10-Q (accession 0001193125-26-330592), same line: $(44,444) thousand for H1 2026 vs $(48,631) thousand for H1 2025.); an override never replaces a filed value — see overrides_applied and override_impact
BASE_DIVERGENCE: latest FY OE/share 5.37 vs 3-yr median 2.07 — one of them is distorted; find out which and why

override_impact.basis: engine-native normalized base (median of last 3 FY) and weighted IRR, DCF run both ways (zero-fill baseline vs with-override); a --base-oe-ps TTM base is excluded from both sides — its override effect shows in ttm.py output
